title: Why Do Cut Apples Turn Brown?
description: Why does a cut apple turn brown? The simple science of enzymes, air and why lemon juice helps.
comment: Do you eat brown apples or throw them? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does a cut apple turn brown so fast?
Apple cells hold an enzyme and special chemicals, kept apart. Cutting breaks the cells, and they mix.
With oxygen from the air, the enzyme turns those chemicals into brown pigments.
Lemon juice slows this, because its acid and vitamin C get in the way.
Cold water, or the fridge, also slows it down.
And a brown apple is usually still fine to eat.
